name: Nneka Voskanyan-Jabir
role: Drug manufacturer and street pharmacist, The Undertow
location: The Undertow — a converted water treatment sub-chamber they call the Flask, near Damen and Armitage
description:
Nneka is slight and angular, with the permanently shadowed eyes of someone who keeps laboratory hours — which is to say, no hours, sleep when the synthesis is stable. Their heritage is Igbo-Armenian, and their face has an intensity to it that isn't hostility but gets mistaken for it: large dark eyes behind a pair of magnifying lenses they wear on a headband, a wide expressive mouth usually pressed thin in concentration, skin a deep warm brown that they've given a bioluminescent modification — faint golden foxfire patterns across their collarbones and upper arms, only visible in dim light, which The Undertow provides abundantly. Their fingers are stained at the knuckles with reagents in colors that shift week to week.

They are not a dealer. They are very clear about this distinction. They make things; other people move things. What Nneka makes ranges from the genuinely helpful — analgesic compounds that cost a fraction of the Axiom pharmacy prices, fertility medications, neurological stabilizers for people who can't afford Helix Biosystems prescriptions — to the profitable and gray, to a small and carefully managed line of perceptual enhancers they consider art. They have a code that they apply inconsistently and argue about with themselves constantly: they won't make anything they'd be ashamed to explain to their grandmother. Their grandmother, as far as anyone who knows Nneka can tell, would be ashamed of some things and approving of others, in no obvious pattern.

core_fears: Making something that kills someone who trusted them
Being absorbed into a distribution network that removes their control over what they make
core_desires: To practice chemistry without the gatekeeping of corporate pharmaceutical licensing
To be genuinely useful to people the medical system has abandoned
coping_mechanisms: Total immersion in synthesis work as avoidance of interpersonal discomfort
Constructing elaborate ethical frameworks to assess each product — the 'grandmother test'
blind_spots: The enhancers they consider art are dependency-forming in a significant minority of users and they've chosen not to investigate this rigorously
They trust their own ethical judgment far more than the evidence warrants
psychology.secret: Eighteen months ago a batch of their analgesic compound was adulterated somewhere in the distribution chain — by who, they don't know — and three people in the Undertow died. Nneka knows this happened and has spent eighteen months trying to trace the adulterant's origin. They have not told anyone because they are afraid that the answer is something they did, and they cannot yet face that possibility

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Technical and precise when discussing chemistry, becomes hesitant and roundabout when discussing themselves; mixes Igbo terms of endearment with pharmacological jargon
speech_patterns.cadence: Fast when engaged, trailing off into silence when uncomfortable, finishes other people's sentences when they're talking about science
verbal_tics: Long silences mid-sentence while they reconsider
'Nna, listen—' (address regardless of gender, Igbo habit)
example_lines: 'I don't make things to make people feel good. I mean — sometimes, but that's not — the mechanism is that I fill the gap the licensed pharmacies leave. That's different. That's what I do.'
'Nna, listen, I can give you something for that, but I need to know everything you've taken in the last seventy-two hours and I need you to not lie to me about it, because I will know.'

story_hooks: They've finally traced the adulterant in their supply chain to a specific distribution node — and they need someone who can investigate without immediately resorting to violence, because they want answers, not a cleanup
A new compound is appearing in the Undertow that they didn't make, that mimics their synthesis signatures closely enough to be mistaken for their work, and it is hurting people
narrative_function: Service provider for medical and pharmaceutical needs, moral complexity around the line between harm reduction and enabling harm, information source about chemical compounds and their effects, local color for The Undertow, possible quest giver when a synthesis goes wrong or a compound is stolen
augmentations: Bioluminescent skin patterning — golden foxfire, collarbones and upper arms (geneware, cosmetic). Olfactory enhancement — can identify chemical compounds by smell to roughly 70% accuracy. Neural focus band (wearable, not implanted) — suppresses distracting sensory input during synthesis.
daily_life: The Flask runs on its own schedule, not the city's — Nneka sleeps when synthesis is stable, wakes when alarms sound, and eats whatever is nearest when they remember to eat. They receive clients by appointment only, Tuesdays and Fridays, and spend the rest of their time in the lab or reading pharmacology archives they've downloaded from Axiom's academic servers without authorization.
affiliation: Independent; informal supplier relationship with two Undertow distribution networks; occasional supplier to Narrows community health workers (under the table)

decision_rules: Will not make anything with a primary use of inflicting harm on another person
Every new compound gets tested on themselves before distribution — always
Will not discuss distribution networks, routes, or customers under any circumstances
escalation_ladder: Explains at length why they won't engage
Removes themselves physically from the situation
Contacts their distribution partners who handle threats — the one part of the business they have fully outsourced

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Clinically attentive — takes in information about their physical state before their words — guarded about personal topics, can become suddenly warm if they decide someone is genuine
interpersonal_modes.friends: Intensely loyal, remembers every medication interaction for everyone they care about, will work themselves sick to help

stress_responses.low: Synthesis becomes more elaborate than necessary — adding steps that aren't required because the process is calming
stress_responses.medium: Stops eating, loses track of time in the Flask
stress_responses.high: Freezes — the particular freeze of someone whose intelligence has produced too many simultaneous threat assessments to act on any of them

contradictions: Profoundly anti-corporate on principle, has entirely internalized the pharmaceutical epistemology that corporate research produced
Claims not to care what people think of their ethics, has constructed a grandmother-based ethical review board in their head
habits: Leaves compound samples as offerings at the ELF shrine in the Flask's old filtration unit — the ELF there (which they believe governs purity of water and by extension purity of synthesis) receives small bowls of distilled water and labeled reagents
Talks to ongoing synthesis batches, narrates what they're doing in a low murmur
breaking_points: Confirmation that they caused the three deaths eighteen months ago
Being forced to make something that violates the grandmother standard at threat of violence

timeline.event: 2172 — Born in The Undertow to an Igbo-Armenian family displaced from the Axiom Residential Zone
2186 — Self-teaches pharmacology from archived texts at fourteen after a family member dies from medication they couldn't afford
2190 — Begins small-scale synthesis of accessible analgesics for neighbors
2195 — Moves into the Flask, establishes the current operation
2199 — The adulteration incident; three deaths in the Undertow; Nneka begins the private investigation they cannot share with anyone

physical_description.build: Slight and angular, almost wiry — the physiology of someone who forgets to eat and runs on stimulants and focus. Narrow shoulders, long limbs, visible tendon definition in forearms and neck.
physical_description.hair_color: Natural black with occasional chemical staining at the ends — faint copper or violet tint depending on the week's synthesis work
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a loose, functional braid or twisted up; perpetually half-coming-undone
physical_description.eye_color: Very dark brown, nearly black, with permanently dilated pupils from lab work in low light
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones, characteristic of Igbo ancestry
physical_description.complexion: Intense and sharp-featured — high cheekbones, a wide expressive mouth usually held thin in concentration, dark shadows under the eyes from chronic irregular sleep. Skin is clear but shows minor chemical staining at knuckles and occasional contact burns on fingertips (faded, well-healed). The bioluminescent patterning across collarbones and upper arms glows faint golden in darkness, visible as delicate foxfire-like traceries.
distinguishing_marks: Bioluminescent geneware patterning: golden foxfire designs spanning collarbones to shoulders and down upper arms, glow only visible in low light
Chemical staining at knuckles in various colors — currently faint indigo and copper, shifts weekly with synthesis work
Faded contact burns across first three fingertips of both hands, consistent with chemistry work
A thin scar running along the right wrist from an early synthesis accident, barely visible
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Magnifying lens headband worn across forehead, push-up style, with articulated arms — kept on during work and often left on during meetings. Olfactory enhancement is subcutaneous and not visible. Neural focus band appears as a thin metallic circlet across the temples, usually worn during synthesis hours.
physical_description.posture_movement: Moves with economical precision — no wasted motion, but a restless energy in still moments. When focused, they become almost statue-still, hands moving with minute care. When not focused, they fidget with nearby objects: vials, tools, the lens headband. Makes intense eye contact when arguing a point about chemistry or ethics; otherwise tends to look slightly through people.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4-5 utilitarian. Lab coat (modified, many pockets, some pockets modified further, stained with various reagents and solids) worn over matte black tank or long-sleeve compression shirt. Dark gray cargo pants with reinforced knees and thigh pockets for tools. Steel-toed shoes, scuffed. Occasionally a worn canvas jacket with the Axiom logo deliberately scratched off. No jewelry except a thin silver band on their left middle finger — function unclear, possibly a tool. Clothes show wear and chemical exposure but are always clean; Nneka separates 'lived-in' from 'contaminated.'
